note: Blob payloads are preserved as content-addressed references (the blob_id digest plus the origin file id), never materialized into the RDF IR, which must stay value-light for arbitrarily large payloads (e.g. multi-terabyte data dumps). A destination GTS carries the reference; the payload bytes are streamed origin->destination on demand (deferred materialization).
`purrdf_gts::reader::read()` folds all segments into one term table, collapsing per-segment blank-node scope; the distinct scopes are recovered only via the streaming-event importer.

A GTS file compares a language tag bytewise; a dataset holds the tag folded to ASCII lower case, so a tag that is not already lower case loses its written spelling and two terms that differ only in tag case become one. The content digest of the file is computed over the terms as written.
